description: Use when you need to know whether a transaction succeeded on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: receipt status, block, confirmations, gas used, effective gas price. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/receipt, $0.002 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Returns the outcome; for the transaction fields (from, to, value, input) use evm_transaction.
name: evm_receipt
title: EVM receipt
